study_identification_part.si_4_title: Beyond homogeneity: charting the landscape of heterogeneity in neurodevelopmental and psychiatric electroencephalography

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Five datasets were aggregated: HBN (Healthy Brain Network Dataset), MIPDB (Multimodal Resource for Studying Information Processing in the Developing Brain), ABCCT (Autism Biomarker Consortium for Clinical Trials Dataset), femaleASD (Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD), and LausanneASD. All used 128-channel HD-EEG systems. HBN was the largest dataset with 1539 out of 2234 total subjects.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: The data were aggregated from five distinct studies: the Healthy Brain Network Dataset (HBN)... Multimodal Resource for Studying Information Processing in the Developing Brain (MIPDB)... Autism Biomarker Consortium for Clinical Trials Dataset (ABCCT)... Multimodal Developmental Neurogenetics of Females with ASD (femaleASD)... and LausanneASD.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: All datasets contributed to both the healthy control reference population (for normative model construction) and the clinical cohort (for heterogeneity assessment). HC subjects were split into training set (n=448) for model development and held-out test set (n=112) for comparison against clinical groups. Clinical groups (ADHD, ASD, ANX, LD) were projected onto the trained models to calculate deviation scores.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort... subjects with ASD, ADHD, ANX, and LD, along with an HC(test) group were projected on these models to calculate their deviation scores
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Ebadi2024.pdf.md: Data description (Results), L41-42; Normative modeling, L45-47

model-1.model-name: EEG normative model (spectral power and functional connectivity)

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: A single normative modeling framework was developed using GAMLSS, applied to both spectral power features (at each channel and frequency band) and functional connectivity features (at each connection and frequency band). The reference population of 560 healthy controls was split into 448 for training and 112 for held-out testing.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: Our cohort consisted of 2234 individuals, subdivided into a group of healthy controls (n=448 in the training set, n=112 in the held-out testing set)... Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort.

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Age statistics are reported for the entire cohort (including both HC and patients) as mean=9.99, sd=3.06 years, range 5-18 years. Separate age statistics for only the healthy control training set are not reported. The age range of 5-18 years applies to all subjects included in the study, so it can be inferred that the training set HC also falls within this range.
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Subjects included in this study were aged between 5 and 18 years old (mean = 9.99 +/- 3.06; 45% M, Fig. S1)... Our cohort consisted of 2234 individuals, subdivided into a group of healthy controls (n=448 in the training set, n=112 in the held-out testing set) and a group of 1674 participants clinically diagnosed with psychiatric disorders
dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.location: Ebadi2024.pdf.md: METHODS Dataset, L141; Ebadi2024_sup.docx.md: Methods / Datasets, L9

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: HC training set: 448 subjects (52% male = 233 male, 48% female = 215 female). HC test set: 112 subjects (55% male = 62 male, 45% female = 50 female). Overall HC: 560 subjects (male: 233+62=295 calculated, but paper reports 52% for train suggesting ~291 male overall and ~269 female overall based on weighted calculation). The percentages are calculated from the reported 52% M for train and 55% M for test.
dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.supporting_text: Models were trained on 448 (52% M) healthy controls (HC) and 112 (55% M) healthy subjects were held out as a comparison group against the clinical cohort.
